guard: raw NATS transport liveness is epoch-safe and separate from full endpoint readiness
why: The deterministic status queues grade the exact nats.js lifecycle contract without timing a broker outage. The companion broker smoke separately proves real public disconnect and reconnect events reach these paths.
Core is rebuilt before each run and after every restore because connector-core resolves @cotal-ai/core through dist. Connector-core's agent source is imported relatively by the suite.
The full predicted kill sets, including every exclusion, are recorded in the suite header before this config is run.

mutations.expectRed: late disconnect and close from the OLD epoch are ignored after the replacement is current
mutations.cell: late disconnect and close from the OLD epoch are ignored after the replacement is current

mutations.name: disconnect status no longer produces a transport edge
mutations.find: this.emit("transport", { connected: false, server: s.server } satisfies TransportState);

mutations.cell: a NATS disconnect makes transport false WITHOUT flapping full-bind readiness

mutations.cell: the distinguishable NATS reconnect edge restores transport without another readiness event
